description: This source file defines the class MidiEventThread, which extends MidiEventScheduler, and manages a thread for handling MIDI events asynchronously. It includes inner class EventThread that processes MIDI events, dispatches them, and provides methods to start and stop the event processing thread. The class interacts with Android's MIDI APIs and logging facilities.

classes.name: MidiEventThread
classes.description: Extends MidiEventScheduler to manage a dedicated thread for MIDI event handling and dispatching.

classes.name: EventThread
classes.description: Inner class extending Thread, responsible for the asynchronous processing and dispatching of MIDI events.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the EventThread to process MIDI events asynchronously.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Requests the EventThread to stop and waits for its termination.

methods.name: getSender
methods.description: Returns the MidiSender object associated with the dispatcher for sending MIDI data.

methods.name: requestStop
methods.description: Signals the EventThread to stop processing and exit the run loop.
